result.title: A CPU-Only Framework for Mining Collectively-Behaving Bots in MMORPGs
result.summary: MMORPGs continually face automated programs (bots) that disrupt gameplay balance and in-game economies. An unsupervised Transformer framework can mine collectively behaving bot groups, but its multi-GPU training is costly in live operations. We show that such GPU-trained sequence models are not strictly necessary for this task. Our CPU pipeline pairs zone embeddings learned from movement context, which place teleport-linked zones close together, with a training-free coordinate kernel, and then applies density clustering. It trains 3-5$\times$ faster than the GPU-based Transformer (56-86$\times$ on the same CPU) while matching its mining quality on two commercial MMORPGs, and has been deployed since late 2024. We also share deployment lessons on how to set the clustering threshold and when to retrain.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出一个纯 CPU 的 MMORPG 机器人群体挖掘流程，用移动上下文学习区域嵌入并配合免训练坐标核与密度聚类，替代多 GPU Transformer，并在两款商业游戏中匹配其挖掘质量。
